searchText: I want to create an EIP to lower or set the `R_sclear` and `R_selfdesctruct` to zero, thereby inhibiting `GST2` gas token and 1inche's `CHI` token. Would this break anything else beside this mint/free spam? They're just spamming the network with `CREATE2` and `SELFDESTRUCT` to effectively buy gas low and sell it (consume it) high. This is a form of abuse of the original intention of the gas refund imo, and is contributing to network congestion https://etherscan.io/address/0x0000000000004946c0e9f43f4dee607b0ef1fa1c#code Look at `function mint(value)` that's where junk contracts are created in a loop depending on how much `value` related: https://twitter.com/ambergroup_io/status/1301177298595590152?s=20 From a productive discussion on twitter I think "externalized costs" > "spam" ... because it is useful to the individuals exercising it but that raises the gas price of *today* unnecessarily. So that delta is what i considered externalized cost
